Over time, many lighthouses have evolved from simple beacon towers to more advanced systems, yet their core purpose of guiding remains unchanged, continuing to connect people to the sea they have always relied on.

Today, lighthouses are not just historical landmarks but also popular tourist destinations that attract visitors from around the world, offering a unique glimpse into coastal culture and the history of maritime exploration. Their enduring presence continues to inspire awe and respect, reminding us of the importance of safety and the beauty of the natural world that surrounds us.
